notes.title: Pool Nation FX - update, pool hall & loyalty discount
notes.content:
Pool Nation FX is out and in the middle of its second update, so I thiought I'd keep you abreast of our progress so far and this ones a big one! 
*As loyal customers you recieve a loyalty discount for owning Pool Nation and this expires on 7th November. Thanks again for all your feedback.... http://store.steampowered.com/app/314000/

[b] This update see's the Introduction of the first stage of the Pool Hall, a living online pool experience, bringing digital pool to life...[/b] 

[h1]The Pool Hall Menu[/h1] 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397800674094438446/1063B9DF595963AEC968367AFD52A398FFF21D76/[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=543504286
The Pool Hall is much more than an online menu. This is the online hub where all online matches are displayed, joined, created and edited in one place. Live updates of the table state are displayed, so this menu itself feels alive. 

This is only the first stage of the pool hall experience, soon you will be able to spectate matches, join in group chat, play winner stays on and more.  

[h1]A New way to create a match[/h1] 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397800674094452691/5A5FD03D74C20160EF6EF7572BC13852CC4E1954/[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=543510147
From one menu you can create and edit your matches, all while watching for new matches to join the pool hall - never miss a match again. 

[h1]The new pool hall venue[/h1]

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397800674094455315/5981A382517C054951CE744B579BB2899CFD8A3B/[/img]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=543510604
The Pool Hall implementation in its first stage is not just a new online menu experience we have also created a new online venue. 

[h1]Snooker Rules Updated[/h1]
Include: 
Spotting balls correctly 
Baulk colours spotted correctly 
Updated points accounted correctly on a foul 

[h1]Table friction in Snooker and Pool [/h1]
We have altered the table friction before the implementation of the slider to ensure the default speeds we are working on feel correct this has been updated for Snooker and Pool 

[h1][u]Full Patch Notes:[/u] 
- Snooker players now break correctly, playing a proper snooker break. 
- Mute/unmute hints when using controller
- Accepting invite from main menu no longer disables the controller
- Hot swapping between mouse/kb enabled throughout
- Resolution options filled from list of resolutions supported by the monitor
- Endurance best time now retrieved when going to endurance menu
- Removed hints from overhead view
- Can now choose from 3 different 'watch' camera types
- Disabled text chat in single player
- Fixes for graphics menu not working correctly with controller
- Brand new online Map.  The pool hall.
- Fixed an issue with drawing double info on tour win when we had endurance bonus match
- Fixed horrible noise playing sometimes when a ball is entering a pocket
- Increased speed of tables and started the basics for implementing a table - speed option
- Update drop stop music correctly if we foul/restart endurance.
- Reduced the occurrence of the random crash bug.
- Fixed issue with preferences being lost if you play in offline mode
- Prize fund now drawn on HUD when in Play For Cash
- Respotting balls in snooker now follows official snooker rules
- Player can now claim the frame when they are on black and >7 points ahead in snooker
- Hitting reds on two consecutive shots now gives 7 points away instead of 4.
- Endurance sound/music coming back when fouling in drop stop.
- New resolutions listing.
- Controller speeds on some menus.
- New follow ball camera.
- New game mode in pool hall to create match and easily play with aiming aid off.[/h1]

notes.title: UPDATE RELEASED: including the Box of Tricks
notes.content:
Here is the offical changelog for the Cherry Popping good Bonfire night update :) 

[list]
 [*]Box of tricks unlocked.
 [*]Workshop integration (BETA) added. Share trickshots with other people.
 [*]8Ball UK rules added with Reds and Yellow balls (including leaderboards and online play)
 [*]Walkaround camera added. (Activated/deactivated by pressing A when it is your turn)
 [*]New 'mode' icons to indicate which view mode you are in. (walkaround, shot taking, replaying etc)
 [*]Fix to hopefully prevent non-gaming/unsupported devices interfering with controls (steering wheels etc)
 [*]Replay HUD visuals updated to now show replay speed in a more elegant way.
 [*]Reply control panel can now be hidden (by clicking the left stick on controller)
 [*]Fixed incorrect reflection maps being used on cues/tables in certain locations
 [*]We no longer display the 'archive_' prefix when listing saved archive matches.
 [*]Alt-Tab crash fixed
 [*]Favouriting shots with controller now has correct button hint.
 [*]Floating balls over pockets in Endurance are now frame rate independent.
 [*]Online 'spectator' bug where both players think it is other other player's turn fixed.
 [*]New foul messages for UK 8 Ball specific fouls
 [*]Nominating with keyboard and mouse in Straight now works correctly
 [*]Fixed issue with 'Force Forfeit' message being shown at incorrect times.
 [*]Pre-order Stripy skin pack unlocked, only those who pre-ordered Pool Nation will be able to use these skins, and every object pack you add to your Pool Nation account there after you will get the Pre-order stripy skin for also.
[/list]

[u] New DLC Added: [/u]
[list]

[/list]

Thank you again for all your support and good wishes over the past year, your commitment, ideas, and bug finding helps us to support this game now and into the future - thank you! 

We hope you enjoy this update, 

CPx

notes.title: Update launch date confirmed
notes.content:
To confirm the update now has a confirmed launch date, (yey!) next wednesday 5th November, this is due to a number of bug fixes highlighted from our kind beta testers and a fix for the spectator bug online that has been brought to our attention via the Steam community, where you would play online and be unable to take a shot - this is fixed in this update (or so it seems) but this did cause a few other issues that need vigorous testing. 

We would not like to send it live tomorrow before the weekend, when the office is unmanned,  we want to be on hand to support the update, should anything need our attention, so I hope you will all join us for a game on Wednesday :) 

Those who want to get help beta test over the weekend please do get in touch the more the merrier - we really appreciate all your help. 

Thanks again and Happy Halloween 

Cpx

notes.title: Pool Nation Gets a Bumper Update!
notes.content:
You have probably heard rumours that we are planning an update (yey!!!!) I just wanted to post an official announcement that we are, it's true, and this update will include, but not limited to, the following: 

[list]
   [*]The Box of Tricks - unlocked - our sandbox mode developed for the creation of trickshots, this is a workshop enabled feature and provides another element to the game of billiards. Add objects to the table, move your balls around and shoot them in the air! Do what you wish with our balls, in this mode, the more creative the better! 

   [*]Reds and Yellows with UK rules - enough said! :) 

   [*]Free Cam - so you can walk around the table

   [*]New mode icons to show which camera mode you are in to help with new free cam

   [*]You can now enter overhead when in free cam

   [*]New replay display that shows you your playback speed in a nicer way.

   [*]You can now hide the replay panel in replay mode.

   [*]Fix for incorrect reflection maps being used on cues/tables in certain locations.

   [*]Saved archive matches now omit the prepended 'archive_' from the file name when displayed.

   [*]Further fix to prevent non-gaming devices interfering with controls.
[/list]

 [i]*this is just a breif list, a full changelog will be included with the update.[/i] 

The update is going through the final stages of testing now, and all going well will be released next week!!! 

Enjoy :) 

CPx

notes.title: Changelog V1.42 (Hotfix)
notes.content:
As you know we like to keep you updated on any major fixes..

The last build update introduced a fairly serious bug where you could start an online game before the other person selected 'Ready'. This strangely caused bad things to happen - and we don't want that do we? :)

You'll be pleased to know this has now been fixed in the new build.

notes.title: Patch History to date V1.09
notes.content:
[h1] Nov 20th, V1.09 [/h1]
You can now enter free play while waiting in the lobby.
Added ability to chat with your opponent in game 
and in the lobby by pressing 'T'.
New 'Universal search' for online matches. Search now shows you all available matches (ranked, player, tournament) on same search results screen.
Redesign of the online menu system flow to match the new universal search.
Lots of work done to the online system in general to reduce number of missing lobbies, joining failures, hanging lobbies etc.
Fixed bug where if you played an online game with private slots (even as client), any game you subsequently set up would have a private slot set up automatically, which meant nobody could find your lobby.
You can now create a match from the search results screen.
Fixed bug with your lobby being left hanging around if you accepted an invite while in a lobby

[h1] Nov 06, V1.07 [/h1]
Endurance music doesn't cut out
Endurance stats can be cycled with mouse
Accepting an invite from a lobby no longer leaves that lobby hanging
Overall score on leaderboard was incorrect
Anomalous scores on leaderboards should slowly start to dissapear

[h1] Nov 05, V1.06 [/h1]
    Added new 'Champion' aiming aid setting, and restored original 'Pro' aiming aid.
    Removed Halloween splash screen (balls and decals are still available to use)
    Online menus re-designed slightly to give more information and better functionality.
    Fixed issue with online search results not clearing out old entries when you select 'search again'.

[h1] Oct 28, V1.05 [/h1] 
    Archive matches that were archived from being the client in an online game are now controllable when you load them.
    Translation updates
    Fixed leaderboard arrows becoming stuck when clicking them with mouse.
    Stabalised the camera when in leaderboard.
    Fixed arrows on post match stats screen not being clickable.
    Fix for the 'archive' button not working when you finished an online game.

[h1] Oct 25, V1.04 [/h1] 
    New control switching ability for mouse input.
    Change to pro aiming aid, only shows cue ball trajectory (community request)
    Added Halloween splash screen, balls and decals.
    Fix for phantom, unjoinable lobbies.
    Lobby screen now ignores mouse when you're using the controller.
    Launcher now shows correct number of render devices.

[h1] Oct 24, V1.03 [/h1] 
    Ball in hand controlled with mouse.
    Unlocks (cues, decals, players etc) awarded correctly (and retrospectively)
    Windowed mode preference on launcher is now saved.
    Achievements that players haven't received (but should have) are now awarded retrospectively.

[h1] Oct 22, V1.02 [/h1] 
    Fixed missing music and fmvs, fix for missing unlocks
    Free play now uses player's tour aiming aid setting.
    Fix for bug where both online players would enter 'spectator mode' at the start of a new frame in a multi frame match.
